[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: cover static/skinned batch planning, world-space merging, exclusions and summary invariants

impact_assessment.why: batch planning and merging drive draw-call savings but the testbed covers them only indirectly through merge_batches in asset tests; edge cases and skinned grouping are untested.
impact_assessment.benefits: Five tests pin static grouping, skinned keying by joints/binds/world, material-based world-space merges, exclude-by-id/name, empty plans and merge/plan count agreement.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: in-memory scenes/meshes; no game/sim/hash change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Small explicit-id scenes, full suite, determinism and project gates.
